senses.en: A raised area of land, usually lower than a mountain.

ex.en: We climbed the hill and watched the sunset.
Building houses on steep hills can increase construction costs and expose residents to the risk of landslides.

col: rolling hills｜những ngọn đồi trập trùng
tip: hill thường thấp hơn mountain, nhưng không có ranh giới độ cao thống nhất.

senses.en: after the expected time or near the end of a period
after the expected time or towards a period's end
used before mentioning a person who has died

ex.en: I was late because my bicycle had a flat tyre.
Students who regularly stay up late may struggle to concentrate and perform well in morning classes.

col: in the late stages｜vào giai đoạn sau
tip: late làm trạng từ nghĩa là muộn; lately nghĩa là gần đây, không dùng lẫn.

senses.en: The length of time someone or something has existed.
A period of history with particular features.

senses.zh: già đi; làm cho già đi
senses.en: To become older or make someone or something seem older.

ex.en: My grandmother learned to swim at the age of seventy.
As populations age, governments need to invest more in accessible housing and community healthcare services.

col: the digital age｜thời đại kỹ thuật số
people of all ages｜những người ở mọi lứa tuổi
age gracefully｜già đi một cách duyên dáng
tip: Nói ở tuổi nào dùng at the age of, không dùng in.

senses.en: A sweet food baked from flour, eggs, sugar, and fat.
To cover with a thick layer or form hard lumps.

ex.en: We shared a slice of lemon cake after lunch.
Schools can encourage healthier eating by offering fresh fruit instead of cake at school celebrations.

col: a slice of cake｜một miếng bánh
be caked in mud｜dính đầy bùn dày
tip: Một chiếc bánh nguyên cái là đếm được; nói chung về loại thức ăn này thường không đếm được.

senses.en: a picture made using a camera
to take a picture of someone or something using a camera

ex.en: This photograph shows my grandparents standing beside their first house.
Historical photographs provide valuable evidence of how urban landscapes and everyday lifestyles have changed over time.

tip: Chụp ảnh dùng take a photograph, không dùng make.

senses.en: something you hear

senses.zh: nghe có vẻ; phát ra tiếng
senses.en: to seem a certain way when heard, or produce noise

senses.zh: hợp lý; đáng tin cậy; tốt
senses.en: sensible, reliable, or in good condition

ex.en: The sound of rain woke me before sunrise.
Environmental policies should be based on sound scientific evidence rather than assumptions about public behaviour.

col: sound the alarm｜rung chuông báo động
tip: sound theo sau là tính từ; sound like theo sau là danh từ.

senses.en: the legal status of belonging to a particular country
a group sharing a national identity, culture, or history

ex.en: The application form asks for my nationality and address.
Access to essential healthcare should depend on medical need rather than a person's nationality or income.

col: people of different nationalities｜những người có quốc tịch khác nhau
tip: nationality chỉ quốc tịch, không đồng nghĩa với nơi sinh hay dân tộc.

senses.en: A straight tool for measuring lengths or drawing straight lines.

senses.zh: người cai trị; nhà cầm quyền
senses.en: A person who governs a country or territory.

ex.en: Use a ruler to draw a straight line here.
The decisions of ancient rulers often influenced trade, architecture, and the daily lives of ordinary people.

col: measure with a ruler｜đo bằng thước
tip: a ruler có thể là cây thước hoặc một người cai trị, cần xem ngữ cảnh.

senses.en: Not closed, or available for people to enter and use.

senses.zh: mở; khai trương; bắt đầu mở cửa
senses.en: To make something accessible or start operating a business.

senses.zh: cởi mở; sẵn sàng tiếp nhận
senses.en: Honest about your thoughts, or willing to consider new ideas.

ex.en: Leave the window open so fresh air can come in.
Governments should remain open to public feedback when developing policies that affect access to essential services.

col: open to the public｜mở cửa cho công chúng
open to suggestions｜sẵn lòng nghe lời khuyên
keep an open mind｜giữ tư tưởng cởi mở
tip: be open chỉ trạng thái đang mở; open làm động từ chỉ hành động mở ra.

senses.en: A person who sings, especially as a job.

ex.en: The singer smiled as the audience began to clap.
Local festivals provide young singers with valuable opportunities to perform publicly and develop confidence in their abilities.

tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ của sing lần lượt là sang, sung.

senses.en: matching the facts rather than being false or invented
having the essential qualities expected of someone or something
remaining loyal to a person, belief, or principle

ex.en: Is it TRUE that your cat can open doors?
Students must assess whether online claims are TRUE before using them as evidence in academic essays.

col: true story｜một câu chuyện có thật
tip: true nhấn mạnh phù hợp với sự thật; real nhấn mạnh thực sự tồn tại.

senses.zh: truyền hình; chương trình truyền hình
senses.en: broadcast programmes with moving pictures and sound
a device used to watch broadcast or streamed programmes
the industry that produces and broadcasts television programmes

ex.en: We watched a wildlife programme on television after dinner.
Educational television can introduce children to scientific ideas that are difficult to demonstrate in classrooms.

tip: watch television không có mạo từ; một chiếc tivi dùng a television.

senses.en: The rear part of your body or of something else.
Towards the rear, or to a previous place or state.
To support a person, plan, or organization.

ex.en: My back feels stiff after sitting all morning.
Local residents are likely to back transport projects that reduce congestion and improve access to employment.

col: back a proposal｜ủng hộ một đề xuất
at the back of｜ở phía sau
tip: go back là quay về; back làm động từ có thể nghĩa là ủng hộ.

senses.en: having a colour between black and white
the colour between black and white
dark and cloudy, or lacking cheerfulness

ex.en: My grandfather wears a gray coat every winter.
Replacing gray concrete surfaces with green spaces can make urban neighbourhoods more attractive and welcoming.

tip: gray là cách viết Anh-Mỹ, tiếng Anh-Anh thường viết grey.

senses.en: any person, without restriction
a person, used in questions and negative statements

ex.en: Anyone can join our weekend walk by the river.
Public libraries should provide free internet access to anyone who needs it, regardless of income.

col: almost anyone｜hầu như bất kỳ ai
tip: Làm chủ ngữ thì động từ chia số ít; any one nhấn mạnh một người bất kỳ.

senses.en: Very pleasing to see, hear, or experience.

ex.en: The garden looks beautiful after the spring rain.
Protecting beautiful natural landscapes can attract visitors while preserving valuable habitats for future generations.

tip: Có thể miêu tả phong cảnh, âm thanh, v.v.; so sánh hơn là more beautiful.

senses.en: a hard structure in the mouth used for biting and chewing
a pointed part of a tool, comb or wheel

ex.en: The dentist checked each tooth with a small mirror.
Regular dental checkups can help prevent tooth decay and reduce the need for expensive treatment.

tip: Số nhiều bất quy tắc là teeth, nguyên âm cũng đổi.

senses.en: To become calm and comfortable, or make someone feel this way.
To make muscles less tight, or become less tight.
To make rules or restrictions less strict.

ex.en: I like to relax with music after dinner.
Regular access to green spaces helps urban residents relax and may improve their overall mental health.

col: sit back and relax｜ngả lưng và thư giãn
tip: Người cảm thấy thư giãn dùng relaxed; vật khiến người ta thư giãn dùng relaxing.

senses.en: The warmest season, between spring and autumn.

ex.en: We often eat outside during the long summer evenings.
Rising summer temperatures may increase demand for electricity as more households rely on air conditioning.

tip: Nói chung vào mùa hè có thể dùng in summer; tên mùa thường viết thường.

senses.en: People or things together or connected by a shared feature.
Arrange people or things together, often according to shared features.

ex.en: A group of cyclists stopped outside the village bakery.
Teachers can group students by their learning needs to provide more effective support during classroom activities.

tip: a group of thường theo sau là danh từ số nhiều; động từ thường dùng group A by B.

senses.en: a person who belongs to a group or organisation

ex.en: Each club member brought a dish to share.
Every member of a community can contribute to protecting local green spaces through regular volunteer work.

col: a team member｜thành viên trong nhóm
a family member｜thành viên gia đình
a founding member｜thành viên sáng lập
tip: Chỉ thành viên của một nhóm thì dùng a member of.

senses.en: an animal living in water with fins; its edible flesh
to try to catch fish

ex.en: We watched small fish swimming under the wooden bridge.
Eating locally caught fish can support coastal communities, provided that fishing practices protect marine ecosystems.

tip: Nhiều con cá thường vẫn dùng fish; thịt cá là danh từ không đếm được.

senses.en: Someone's female child.

ex.en: Their daughter made pancakes for the whole family.
Equal access to education ensures that daughters and sons have similar opportunities to develop their talents.

col: a teenage daughter｜con gái tuổi teen
a mother and daughter｜hai mẹ con (mẹ và con gái)
tip: daughter-in-law là con dâu, không phải con riêng của chồng hoặc vợ.

senses.en: a farm animal kept for its wool, meat or milk

ex.en: Several sheep were resting under a tree near the farm.
Keeping too many sheep on fragile grasslands can damage vegetation and increase the risk of soil erosion.

col: a flock of sheep｜một đàn cừu
tip: sheep có số ít và số nhiều giống nhau; dê là goat.

senses.en: A place where children learn, or the time spent learning there.
A group sharing particular ideas, methods, or styles.
A group of fish swimming together.

ex.en: We walk to school together along the river.
Every school should provide opportunities for students to develop practical skills alongside their academic knowledge.

col: a school of fish｜một đàn cá
tip: go to school là đi học; go to the school là đến khuôn viên trường.

senses.en: every time or on every occasion
throughout all time or for ever

ex.en: My neighbour always waves when she sees me.
Higher levels of economic growth do not always lead to better living conditions for every citizen.

col: not always｜không phải lúc nào cũng
tip: Thường đứng trước động từ thường, sau động từ be; not always là không phải lúc nào cũng.

senses.en: On most occasions, but not always.

ex.en: I usually walk to work unless it rains.
People usually find it easier to maintain healthy habits when their friends and family offer support.

col: as usually happens｜như vẫn thường xảy ra
tip: Thường đứng trước động từ thường, sau động từ be.

senses.en: Past events, or the study of them.

senses.zh: quá trình; hồ sơ trước đây
senses.en: A record of someone's or something's past experiences or conditions.

ex.en: Our guide explained the history of the old castle.
Studying history helps citizens understand how past decisions continue to shape modern societies and institutions.

col: throughout history｜suốt chiều dài lịch sử
tip: historical chỉ liên quan đến lịch sử; historic chỉ có ý nghĩa lịch sử.

senses.en: the day after Thursday and before Saturday

ex.en: We usually cook dinner together at home on Friday.
Allowing employees to work from home on Friday may reduce commuting pressure and improve job satisfaction.

tip: Viết hoa chữ cái đầu; dùng on Friday, nhưng next Friday không dùng on.

senses.en: the body parts at the ends of the legs

senses.zh: feet (số nhiều của foot, đơn vị đo)
senses.en: units of length, each equal to twelve inches

ex.en: My feet felt cold against the kitchen tiles.
Designing comfortable footwear can protect the feet of workers who spend most of their day standing.

tip: Số nhiều của foot là feet; khi làm định ngữ trước danh từ thì dùng số ít, như six-foot.

senses.en: To clean something using water, often with soap.
To carry or move something through flowing water.
An act of cleaning with water.

ex.en: Please wash your hands before you help prepare dinner.
Schools should teach children to wash their hands properly to reduce the spread of infectious diseases.

col: give something a wash｜rửa qua một chút
tip: wash nhấn mạnh làm sạch bằng nước; clean là làm sạch nói chung, không nhất thiết dùng nước.

senses.en: A soft seat with a back for several people

ex.en: We curled up on the sofa after dinner.
A comfortable sofa in a shared lounge can encourage residents to spend more time together.

col: sit on the sofa｜ngồi trên sofa
tip: Ngồi trên ghế sofa dùng on the sofa, không dùng in.

senses.en: Making you want to pay attention or learn more.

ex.en: We found an interesting little museum near the station.
The survey revealed an interesting connection between access to green spaces and residents' overall satisfaction with urban life.

col: an interesting question｜câu hỏi thú vị
an interesting finding｜phát hiện đáng chú ý
find something interesting｜thấy việc gì đó thú vị
tip: interesting miêu tả sự vật gây hứng thú, không đồng nghĩa với funny (buồn cười).

senses.en: A cereal plant whose grains are cooked and eaten.

ex.en: We had rice with steamed fish for dinner.
Improved irrigation methods can help farmers grow rice while using less water in regions affected by drought.

col: a bowl of rice｜một bát cơm
tip: rice thường không đếm được; một hạt gạo dùng a grain of rice.

senses.en: A particular part of a place or geographical region
The amount of surface that something covers
A particular subject or part of an activity

ex.en: There is a quiet picnic area beside the lake.
Investment in public transport can improve access to employment for people living in rural areas.

col: an area of research｜lĩnh vực nghiên cứu
tip: Khi chỉ diện tích thường dùng đơn vị như mét vuông; cũng có thể chỉ lĩnh vực nghiên cứu.

senses.en: Free from dirt, marks, or unwanted substances.
To remove dirt or unwanted substances from something.
Producing little or no pollution.

ex.en: There are clean towels on the shelf beside you.
Investing in clean energy can reduce air pollution while creating new employment opportunities in developing industries.

col: clean the kitchen｜dọn dẹp nhà bếp
tip: clean là sạch; clear là trong hoặc rõ ràng, không thể dùng lẫn tùy tiện.

senses.en: The activity of buying and selling goods or services.
An organisation that sells goods or services.
Matters that someone needs to deal with or is responsible for.

ex.en: Business is usually slow at the café on Mondays.
Small businesses often create local employment, but they may struggle to compete with larger companies.

col: run a business｜điều hành doanh nghiệp
none of your business｜không phải việc của bạn
tip: Chỉ hoạt động kinh doanh thì không đếm được; chỉ một doanh nghiệp cụ thể thì đếm được.

senses.en: Moving on foot, especially for exercise or pleasure.

ex.en: Walking to the shops takes about ten minutes.
Cities can encourage walking by improving pavement quality and creating safer crossings near schools and shopping areas.

col: walking distance｜khoảng cách đi bộ được
tip: Chữ l trong walking không đọc; đi bộ đến đâu cũng có thể dùng on foot.

senses.en: a word or words used to identify someone or something
to give a name or say what someone is called
the reputation someone or something has

ex.en: What name did you choose for your new kitten?
Companies often choose a memorable name to distinguish their products in an increasingly competitive market.

col: full name｜họ và tên đầy đủ
make a name for yourself｜nổi tiếng
tip: Trong tiếng Anh-Anh, name A after B nghĩa là đặt tên A theo tên B.

senses.en: A place where planes take off, land, and collect passengers

ex.en: We arrived at the airport before the sun rose.
Expanding an airport may boost tourism, but it can also increase noise pollution for nearby residents.

col: airport shuttle｜xe đưa đón sân bay
tip: Ở sân bay thường dùng at the airport; nhà ga hành khách là terminal.

senses.en: many times or on many occasions

ex.en: We often walk by the river after dinner.
People who exercise regularly often report better sleep and higher energy levels throughout the day.

col: as often as possible｜thường xuyên nhất có thể
tip: Thường đứng trước động từ thường, sau động từ be; chữ t cũng có thể được đọc.

senses.zh: đô la; đồng (đơn vị tiền tệ)
senses.en: A currency unit used in the US and several other countries.

ex.en: I paid one dollar for this small notebook.
A stronger dollar can make imported goods cheaper for American consumers while increasing costs for overseas buyers.

col: a strong dollar｜đồng đô la mạnh
the dollar exchange rate｜tỷ giá đô la
tip: Không chỉ là đô la Mỹ, còn dùng cho đô la Canada, đô la Úc, v.v.

senses.en: refers to a thing, animal, or situation already mentioned

senses.zh: chủ ngữ hoặc tân ngữ hình thức
senses.en: used as a grammatical subject or object without naming anything

ex.en: I found your scarf and put it by the door.
It is essential for cities to provide reliable public transport if they want to reduce traffic congestion.

tip: it viết thường là đại từ; IT viết hoa mới là công nghệ thông tin.

senses.en: a very young child or animal

senses.zh: nhỏ; dành cho trẻ sơ sinh
senses.en: very young, or intended for babies

senses.zh: nuông chiều; đối xử như trẻ con
senses.en: treat someone as helpless or needing excessive care

ex.en: The baby fell asleep while her father sang softly.
Affordable childcare helps parents of young babies return to work without placing excessive pressure on family finances.

col: baby food｜đồ ăn cho trẻ em bé
baby clothes｜quần áo trẻ sơ sinh
tip: Số nhiều là babies; baby làm động từ thường hàm ý chăm sóc quá mức.

senses.en: a small animal with long ears, soft fur, and strong back legs

ex.en: A white rabbit hopped across the grass towards us.
Introducing rabbits into new environments can damage native vegetation and disrupt the balance of local ecosystems.

tip: rabbit chỉ thỏ nói chung; hare thường chỉ thỏ rừng có chân và tai dài hơn.

senses.en: The clear liquid people drink and plants need to grow.
To give water to plants or soil.

ex.en: Please water the plants before we leave today.
Access to clean drinking water is essential for preventing disease and improving public health.

tip: Nước thường không đếm được: a glass of water là một ly nước.

senses.en: one of two equal parts of something
equal to one of two equal parts of something
to an extent that is not complete

ex.en: I saved half of my sandwich for later.
Nearly half of the residents surveyed supported creating more green spaces in the city centre.

tip: Số nhiều là halves; nửa giờ dùng half an hour.

senses.en: a tool with a handle and blade used for cutting

ex.en: Use a sharp knife to slice the bread.
Learning to use a kitchen knife safely is an important part of practical food education.

tip: Chữ k không đọc; số nhiều đổi -fe thành -ves: knives.

senses.en: used to tell someone you are grateful

senses.zh: lời cảm ơn; lòng biết ơn
senses.en: words or actions expressing gratitude

ex.en: Thanks for helping me carry these heavy bags upstairs.
Public expressions of thanks can help volunteers feel valued and encourage continued participation in community projects.

col: thanks for your help｜cảm ơn vì đã giúp
express thanks｜bày tỏ lòng biết ơn
tip: thanks for theo sau là danh từ hoặc danh động từ; thanks to nghĩa là nhờ có.

senses.en: Likely to cause harm, injury, or serious problems.

ex.en: That broken step is dangerous, so please avoid it.
Poorly maintained roads can create dangerous conditions for cyclists, especially during heavy rain or after dark.

tip: dangerous là tính từ; bổ nghĩa cho hành động phải dùng dangerously.

senses.en: Information sent or left for someone to read or hear.
The main idea that a story, speech, or artwork communicates.
To send someone an electronic communication.

ex.en: Please leave a message if I miss your call.
Public health campaigns need a clear message that people from different backgrounds can easily understand.

col: leave a message｜để lại lời nhắn
get the message across｜truyền đạt rõ ý
tip: message là danh từ đếm được; information thường không đếm được.

senses.en: the large area of salt water covering much of Earth
a large mass of similar things seen together

ex.en: The children watched small boats sailing across the sea.
Plastic waste entering the sea threatens marine wildlife and can eventually affect human food supplies.

tip: at sea là ngoài biển; by the sea là ở bên bờ biển.

senses.en: a food made from flour and water, usually baked

ex.en: Fresh bread was cooling beside the kitchen window.
Choosing wholegrain bread instead of refined varieties can increase fibre intake and support a balanced diet.

col: a loaf of bread｜một ổ bánh mì
a slice of bread｜một lát bánh mì
tip: bread thường không đếm được; một lát dùng a slice of bread.

senses.zh: ở giữa; giữa (không gian, thời gian)
senses.en: In the space or period separating people, things, or events.

senses.zh: giữa (hai hay nhiều bên); chung nhau
senses.en: Connecting distinct people or groups, or shared by them.
In the space or interval separating things.

ex.en: The cat squeezed between the sofa and the wall.
Cooperation between schools and local businesses can help students develop practical skills before entering employment.

col: a link between｜mối liên hệ giữa
between them｜cùng nhau; giữa họ với nhau
tip: between không chỉ dùng cho hai đối tượng, cũng dùng cho nhiều đối tượng rõ ràng.

senses.en: At, to, or over a great distance.
To a much greater degree.
More distant from you or a particular point.

ex.en: We walked so far that our feet began to ache.
Reliable public transport can make commuting far more affordable for people who live outside major city centres.

col: far from｜tránh xa; còn lâu mới
tip: far có thể bổ nghĩa cho so sánh hơn, như far better; không nói far good.

senses.en: The number after seventeen and before nineteen.

ex.en: We baked eighteen muffins for the picnic this morning.
In many countries, citizens gain the right to vote when they reach the age of eighteen.

tip: eighteen là 18, eighty là 80; chú ý âm cuối.

senses.en: what clocks measure, or a particular point in its passage
an occasion when something happens

senses.zh: tính thời gian; chọn thời điểm
senses.en: to measure duration or choose when something should happen

ex.en: We still have time for a walk before dinner.
Schools should give students enough time to explore creative activities alongside their preparation for formal examinations.

col: spend time doing something｜dành thời gian làm việc gì
tip: Thời gian thường không đếm được; khi chỉ số lần thì đếm được, như three times.

senses.en: An organisation that sells goods or services

senses.zh: sự bầu bạn; sự có mặt của người khác
senses.en: The presence of another person or people with you

ex.en: My sister works for a company that makes bicycles.
A company that invests in staff training is more likely to retain skilled employees over time.

col: work for a company｜làm việc ở một công ty
set up a company｜thành lập công ty
keep someone company｜bầu bạn với ai
enjoy someone's company｜thích ở bên ai
tip: Nghĩa “công ty” đếm được; nghĩa “sự bầu bạn” không đếm được.

senses.en: A room with a bath or shower, often including a toilet.
A room containing a toilet, especially in American English.

ex.en: She hung a clean towel beside the bathroom sink.
Installing water-saving fixtures in the bathroom can help households reduce consumption without changing their daily routines.

col: bathroom sink｜bồn rửa trong phòng tắm
go to the bathroom｜đi vệ sinh
tip: Trong tiếng Anh-Mỹ, bathroom cũng có thể là nhà vệ sinh không có bồn tắm.

senses.en: to move your body rhythmically, usually to music
rhythmic movement to music, or an event for dancing

ex.en: We danced in the kitchen while dinner was cooking.
Traditional dance can strengthen community identity while offering younger generations a connection to their cultural heritage.

tip: Nhảy theo nhạc dùng dance to music, giới từ là to.

senses.en: Liked or preferred more than others

senses.zh: người hoặc vật được yêu thích nhất
senses.en: A person or thing someone likes best
A competitor considered most likely to win

ex.en: This blue sweater is my favorite winter item.
Surveys of children's favorite leisure activities can help local authorities design more appealing public recreation spaces.

col: a favorite pastime｜thú tiêu khiển yêu thích
a firm favorite｜người hoặc vật luôn được yêu thích
the clear favorite to win｜ứng viên vô địch rõ ràng
tip: favorite là cách viết Anh-Mỹ, tiếng Anh-Anh là favourite; thường không dùng most để bổ nghĩa.

senses.en: a drink made by putting tea leaves in hot water
dried leaves used to make tea
a light afternoon meal or, in Britain, an early evening meal

ex.en: I made a pot of tea while you rested.
In many cultures, sharing tea provides an opportunity for conversation and strengthens relationships between generations.

col: a cup of tea｜một tách trà
tip: Nước trà thường không đếm được; khi gọi món, two teas là hai tách trà.

senses.en: to become different, replace something, or exchange money

senses.zh: sự thay đổi; sự biến đổi
senses.en: an instance or process of becoming different
coins, or money returned when you pay more than the price

ex.en: We changed our plans when the rain started falling.
Governments should change transport policies to encourage cycling and reduce dependence on private cars in cities.

tip: Khi nghĩa là tiền lẻ hoặc tiền thối thì không đếm được, không nói a change.

senses.en: a country occupying a continent between the Indian and Pacific Oceans

ex.en: My cousin moved to Australia to study marine biology.
Australia attracts international students through its universities, diverse cities, and opportunities to study in English.

col: travel to Australia｜đi du lịch Úc
study in Australia｜du học ở Úc
tip: Australia là nước Úc; Austria mới là nước Áo.

senses.en: Prepared or available for use or action.
Willing to do something.
About to do something very soon.

ex.en: Dinner is ready, so please bring your plate.
Schools must ensure that students are ready to meet the demands of a rapidly changing workplace.

col: ready to use｜có thể dùng ngay
ready and willing｜sẵn lòng và sẵn sàng
tip: ready for theo sau là danh từ; ready to theo sau là động từ nguyên mẫu.

senses.en: A thought or suggestion about what to do.
A mental understanding or belief about something.
Some knowledge or understanding of a situation.

ex.en: Your idea of growing herbs on the balcony sounds lovely.
The idea of free public transport attracts support, but its financial implications require careful consideration.

col: come up with an idea｜nghĩ ra một ý tưởng
have no idea｜hoàn toàn không biết
tip: idea là danh từ đếm được; “không biết” có thể nói have no idea.

senses.en: Make a picture using a pencil, pen, or similar tool.
Move something by pulling it in a particular direction.
Attract people, interest, or attention to something.

ex.en: She drew a sleeping cat in her sketchbook.
Free cultural events can draw more visitors to museums and encourage wider participation in the arts.

col: draw attention to｜thu hút sự chú ý
draw a conclusion｜rút ra kết luận
tip: Quá khứ drew, quá khứ phân từ drawn; còn có thể chỉ kết quả hòa.

senses.en: Towards or in a lower place or position.
Along something, or from a higher to a lower point.
Feeling unhappy or discouraged.

ex.en: The cat jumped down from the kitchen table.
As housing costs go up, the amount young adults can save often goes down.

col: down the street｜dọc theo con phố
tip: down theo sau là danh từ có thể làm giới từ; feel down nghĩa là tâm trạng đi xuống.

senses.en: A device with moving parts that performs a particular job.
To shape or finish material using a machine.

ex.en: The washing machine shook loudly during its final spin.
A modern machine can perform repetitive tasks efficiently, allowing workers to focus on more complex problems.

tip: machine là danh từ đếm được; machinery là danh từ tập hợp không đếm được.

senses.en: To obtain or receive something.
To become a particular way.
To arrive at a place.

ex.en: I got a warm scarf for my birthday.
Students from low-income families may struggle to get the financial support they need to complete university courses.

tip: Quá khứ là got; tiếng Anh-Mỹ quá khứ phân từ cũng dùng gotten.

senses.en: Used to connect contrasting ideas or correct an earlier statement.
Except for someone or something.

ex.en: The bag looks small, but it holds everything I need.
Public transport can reduce traffic congestion, but services must be reliable enough to attract regular users.

col: not only ... but also ...｜không những mà còn
tip: although và but thường không dùng cùng nhau trong một câu.

senses.en: having the colour of ripe tomatoes
the colour of ripe tomatoes

ex.en: She wore a red coat to the winter market.
Designers often use red to draw attention to important warnings on machinery and in public spaces.

col: in the red｜nợ nần; thua lỗ
tip: in the red nghĩa là nợ nần hoặc thua lỗ, không phải màu đỏ theo nghĩa đen.

senses.zh: cuộc trò chuyện; cuộc đàm thoại
senses.en: A talk in which people exchange ideas, feelings, or information.

ex.en: We had a friendly conversation while waiting for the bus.
Regular conversation with fluent speakers helps language learners develop confidence and improve their listening skills.

col: start a conversation｜bắt đầu cuộc trò chuyện
a conversation about｜cuộc trò chuyện về
tip: Nói chuyện với ai về điều gì: have a conversation with sb about sth.

senses.en: The main meal of the day, usually eaten in the evening.
A formal social occasion at which people eat a meal.

ex.en: Dinner is ready, so please bring the plates.
Sharing dinner regularly can strengthen family relationships by giving everyone an opportunity to discuss their daily experiences.

col: a formal dinner｜tiệc chiêu đãi trang trọng
tip: Trong giao tiếp hằng ngày nói have dinner, không dùng mạo từ; tiệc trang trọng có thể nói a dinner.

senses.en: to carry someone or something to a place
to cause a situation, feeling, or result

ex.en: Please bring a warm coat when you visit.
Improved public transport can bring significant benefits to residents who cannot afford their own cars.

col: bring someone something｜mang thứ gì cho ai
bring about change｜gây ra thay đổi
bring good luck｜mang lại may mắn
tip: bring nhấn mạnh mang đến chỗ người nói hoặc nơi chỉ định; quá khứ là brought.

senses.en: Something that explains why something happens or someone acts.

senses.zh: lý trí; khả năng suy luận
senses.en: The ability to think logically and make sensible judgments.
To think logically in order to reach a conclusion.

ex.en: The heavy rain was the reason we stayed home.
One reason for rising urban rents is that housing supply has failed to keep pace with population growth.

col: a valid reason｜lý do chính đáng
reason with someone｜nói lý với ai
within reason｜trong giới hạn hợp lý
tip: Thường dùng reason for cộng danh từ, hoặc reason why cộng mệnh đề.

senses.en: The world's largest continent, lying mainly east of Europe.

ex.en: My cousin spent three months travelling around Asia.
Rapid urban growth in Asia has increased the need for affordable housing and reliable public transport.

tip: Tên châu viết hoa chữ cái đầu, thường không dùng the; tính từ là Asian.

senses.en: The appearance of something as red, blue, green, and so on.
To give something a colour using pencils, paint, or dye.

ex.en: What colour should we paint the kitchen walls?
The colour of classroom walls may influence students' moods and their ability to concentrate.

col: colour in a picture｜tô màu bức tranh
tip: Tiếng Anh-Anh viết colour, tiếng Anh-Mỹ viết color.

senses.en: one of the two body parts used for seeing

senses.zh: con mắt; khả năng thẩm định
senses.en: an ability to notice or judge particular qualities
to look at someone or something with particular interest

ex.en: She closed her eyes and listened to the rain.
Designers need an eye for detail to create public spaces that are both attractive and accessible.

col: keep an eye on｜để mắt đến; trông nom
an eye for detail｜con mắt tinh tường với chi tiết
catch someone's eye｜thu hút sự chú ý của ai
tip: an eye for chỉ khả năng thẩm định; keep an eye on nghĩa là để mắt trông chừng.

senses.en: The time between midday and evening.

ex.en: We spent the afternoon baking bread in the kitchen.
Schools could offer afternoon sports sessions to help students develop healthier habits and stronger friendships.

tip: Nói chung buổi chiều dùng in; buổi chiều của một ngày cụ thể dùng on.

senses.en: A casual shirt, usually with short sleeves and no collar.

ex.en: I packed a clean T-shirt for the picnic.
Choosing a durable cotton T-shirt instead of disposable fashion can reduce waste and encourage more responsible consumption.

tip: Danh từ đếm được, số nhiều là T-shirts, giữ dấu gạch nối.

senses.zh: kết thúc; phần cuối; đầu mút
senses.en: the final part or furthest point of something
to stop, or cause something to stop
a purpose that someone wants to achieve

ex.en: There's a small bakery at the end of our street.
Governments should aim to end extreme poverty by improving access to education and secure employment.

col: a means to an end｜phương tiện để đạt mục đích
tip: at the end là ở phần cuối; in the end là rốt cuộc.

senses.en: Having a very pleasant taste.

ex.en: This delicious vegetable pie is still warm from the oven.
School meals should be both nutritious and delicious to encourage children to develop healthier eating habits.

tip: delicious tự nó đã mạnh nghĩa, thường được nhấn thêm bằng absolutely.

senses.en: Make or become full
Occupy an empty position or meet a particular need

ex.en: Please fill the jug with water for our guests.
Local training programmes can help fill vacancies in essential services such as healthcare and education.

col: fill in a form｜điền vào mẫu đơn
fill a vacancy｜tuyển người vào vị trí còn trống
tip: fill A with B là đổ đầy A bằng B; be filled with nghĩa là đầy ắp.

senses.en: to start to be something or develop a particular quality

ex.en: The streets become quiet after the shops close.
Public transport must become more reliable and affordable if cities want residents to drive less frequently.

col: become aware of｜bắt đầu nhận ra
become increasingly important｜ngày càng quan trọng
become a teacher｜trở thành giáo viên
tip: Chia động từ become, became, become; theo sau là danh từ hoặc tính từ.

senses.en: Towards or in a higher position.
Towards a higher point or further along something.
Awake and out of bed.

ex.en: The child looked up at the bright red balloon.
As housing costs go up, many young adults find it harder to live independently.

tip: up theo sau là danh từ chỉ nơi chốn có thể làm giới từ, như up the hill.

senses.en: The earth and all the people and things on it.
A particular area of activity and the people involved.

ex.en: She dreams of travelling around the world by train.
Countries around the world need to cooperate more closely to address climate change and protect shared natural resources.

col: the natural world｜thế giới tự nhiên
tip: Chỉ toàn thế giới thường dùng the world; giới kinh doanh là the business world.

senses.en: to take liquid into your mouth and swallow it
a liquid for swallowing or a serving of it
to consume alcoholic beverages

ex.en: I always drink some water after walking the dog.
Encouraging children to drink water instead of sugary beverages may improve their dental health over time.

tip: Bất quy tắc: drink, drank, drunk.

senses.en: A country in North America, south of the United States.

ex.en: We explored ancient ruins during our holiday in Mexico.
Tourism in Mexico creates employment, but popular coastal destinations also face pressure on water supplies and natural habitats.

col: the coast of Mexico｜bờ biển Mê-hi-cô
tip: Phía trước tên nước thường không có the; Mexican nghĩa là thuộc Mê-hi-cô hoặc người Mê-hi-cô.

senses.en: Having a colour between black and white.
The colour between black and white.
Develop grey hair as you get older.

ex.en: A grey cat was sleeping on the windowsill.
Grey concrete buildings can appear less welcoming than neighbourhoods with colourful homes and abundant green space.

tip: grey là cách viết Anh-Anh, gray là cách viết Anh-Mỹ.

senses.en: A large amount of something, used with uncountable nouns.

senses.zh: nhiều; lượng lớn (không nêu danh từ)
senses.en: A large amount, without naming what is being discussed.
To a great degree, especially with comparisons and certain verbs.

ex.en: We do not have much milk left for breakfast.
Investing in preventive healthcare can be much more economical than treating illnesses after they become severe.

tip: Bổ nghĩa cho danh từ không đếm được; danh từ đếm được số nhiều dùng many.

senses.en: To gain knowledge or a skill through study or experience.
To find out information about something.

ex.en: My grandfather is learning to swim at the local pool.
Students often learn more effectively when they apply new knowledge to practical problems rather than memorise isolated facts.

col: learn from mistakes｜học từ sai lầm
tip: learn to do là học cách làm; quá khứ có thể là learnt hoặc learned.

senses.en: the direction opposite north
in, towards, or facing the south

senses.zh: về phía nam; ở phía nam
senses.en: towards or in the south

ex.en: Our balcony faces south and gets plenty of sunshine.
Many families move to the south because its warmer climate allows more outdoor activities throughout the year.

tip: Phía nam dùng in the south; đi về phía nam dùng go south, không thêm to.

senses.zh: có thể; được phép; có khả năng
senses.en: Used to express ability, permission, or possibility.
A metal container for food, drinks, or other substances.
To preserve food by sealing it in cans.

ex.en: I can carry both bags if you open the door.
Access to reliable internet can help rural students benefit from a wider range of educational resources.

col: can afford｜đủ khả năng chi trả
tip: Là động từ khuyết thiếu, theo sau là động từ nguyên mẫu, ngôi thứ ba không thêm s.

senses.en: Used informally to greet someone or attract their attention.

ex.en: Hey, you left your umbrella beside the door!
Informal greetings such as hey may be inappropriate when students first contact university staff by email.

tip: Phù hợp khi chào hỏi người quen; tránh dùng trong email trang trọng.

senses.zh: coca; nước ngọt có ga cola
senses.en: A sweet, dark, fizzy drink, usually containing caffeine.

ex.en: He poured cold cola into a glass with ice.
Reducing the consumption of sugary drinks such as cola may help prevent tooth decay in children.

col: a can of cola｜một lon cola
tip: Nói chung về loại đồ uống thì không đếm được; a cola có thể là một ly hoặc một phần cola.

senses.zh: vòi sen; việc tắm vòi sen
senses.en: Washing under falling water, or the equipment used for this
A short period of rain
Wash your body under water falling from a shower

ex.en: I always take a warm shower after cycling home.
Taking shorter showers is a simple way for households to reduce both water consumption and energy use.

tip: Tắm vòi sen có thể dùng take hoặc have a shower; mưa rào cũng gọi là shower.

senses.en: A tall plant with a wooden trunk and branches.

ex.en: A small bird built its nest in our tree.
Planting trees in urban areas provides shade, improves air quality, and creates valuable habitats for wildlife.

tip: tree là cây; wood có thể là gỗ, woods thường là khu rừng nhỏ.

senses.en: to make structures or develop something over time
the size and shape of a person's body

ex.en: We built a small wooden shelter in the garden.
Local authorities should build more affordable homes near public transport to support families on low incomes.

col: build relationships｜xây dựng mối quan hệ
a slim build｜vóc dáng mảnh khảnh
tip: Quá khứ và quá khứ phân từ đều là built; vóc dáng cũng dùng build.

senses.en: An adult male human
Human beings considered collectively

senses.zh: bố trí người vận hành; trực
senses.en: To provide people to operate or guard something

ex.en: A man in a blue coat held the door open.
Additional volunteers are needed to man information desks during the city's annual cultural festival.

col: man a checkpoint｜làm nhiệm vụ ở trạm kiểm soát
tip: Số nhiều là men; chỉ loài người nói chung, văn viết hiện đại thường dùng humankind.
